title: Tomato jelly
instructions: requires a can of tomatoes, an ounce of gelatine and seasonings. Soak the gelatine in one-half cupful of cold water for half an hour. Meanwhile cook the tomatoes with three tablespoonfuls of vinegar, a teaspoonful of salt, a tablespoonful of sugar and a dash of paprika. Then add the gelatine to the tomatoes and stir until it is dissolved. Strain the jelly through a jelly bag and mold. The tomato jelly may be served on a bed of lettuce with a mayonnaise, as has already been suggested.
